# Paws Forward

> Dog-rescue fundraising organization. Donate any amount, or get a personal QR and earn 50% of attributed gifts.

## Site
- Home: https://joinpawsforward.com/
- Donate: https://joinpawsforward.com/donate
- Get your QR: https://joinpawsforward.com/join
- Privacy: https://joinpawsforward.com/privacy
- Terms: https://joinpawsforward.com/terms

## Notes
- Payments are processed by Stripe.
- Application data is stored with Supabase.
- Volunteer portal is for authorized operators only.
